# Relocation.ge

> Independent, open-source project that structures official Georgian legal provisions
> into clear, source-based guidance for people relocating to Georgia. Each page cites
> primary sources and shows when it was last reviewed.

## Immigration & Visa
- [Guide to Georgian Visas: All Visa Types Explained (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/guide-to-georgian-visas/): Visa-free regime, short-term (A/B/C/transit) and long-term immigration (D1–D5) visas, e-visa, and the 2026 work-permit change.
- [Guide to Residence Permits in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/guide-to-residence-permits/): Overview and comparison of all Georgian residence permit types.
- [Work Residence Permit & the Right to Work in Georgia (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/work-residence-permit-georgia/): The 2026 two-stage system — the right to work from the Ministry of Labour, then a work or IT-employed residence permit; income and turnover thresholds, deadlines, fees, and the remote-work carve-out.
- [The Right to Work in Georgia: Labour-Migration Permit Explained (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/right-to-work-georgia/): Deep guide to the right to work — who needs it, the fourteen statutory exemptions (fully remote work and foreign-client services widened by Law No 1509 of 15 April 2026), how employees and the self-employed apply, the GEL 500 fee cap and 30-day review, refusal and termination grounds, fines, and the 1 January 2027 transitional deadline.
- [Migration to Georgia: What the Official Data Shows (2012–2024)](https://relocation.ge/en/migration-to-georgia-data/): Geostat and ISET migration trends — net flows, the 2022 surge, and top countries of origin.

## Work & Business
- [How to Register an Individual Entrepreneur Remotely (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/register-individual-entrepreneur-remotely/): Registering an IE from abroad via Power of Attorney.
- [Investor Guarantees in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/investor-guarantees-in-georgia/): Rights and protections for foreign investors — national treatment, profit repatriation and expropriation safeguards.
- [Registering a Company in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/registering-a-company-in-georgia/): Business forms, limited liability and registration as both state and tax registration.
- [Running a Company in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/running-a-company-in-georgia/): Governance bodies, the annual general meeting, registry updates and reorganisation.
- [Georgia for Digital Nomads (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/georgia-for-digital-nomads/): Visa-free stay, the 2026 work-permit rule, the 1% small-business tax regime and territorial taxation for remote workers.
- [Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/vasp-georgia/): NBG crypto registration regime since 2023 — what counts as a virtual asset service, who must register, AML/CFT duties, and the ban on paying with crypto.
- [International Company Status in Georgia: 5% tax regime for IT and maritime firms](https://relocation.ge/en/international-company-status-georgia/): Preferential regime under Ordinance No 619 — 5% profit tax, 5% salary tax, property-tax and dividend exemptions, eligibility, permitted activities and how to apply via the Revenue Service.
- [Virtual Zone Person Status in Georgia: 0% tax on exported IT](https://relocation.ge/en/virtual-zone-person-georgia/): IT regime under the Law on Information Technology Zones — profit tax, VAT and export-duty exemption on software supplied outside Georgia, what counts as IT, the export-only condition, and how the status is granted within 10 working days.
- [Startup Support in Georgia: Innovation Tax Statuses, Grants & Accelerators (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/startup-support-georgia/): The June 2025 reform of the Law on Innovations — the Innovative Startup, Innovative SME and R&D Service Provider statuses (up to 10 years of relief, 0% then 5%/10% on salary and profit), GITA grants and 500 Global acceleration, Enterprise Georgia, and how the statuses compare with the Virtual Zone and International Company regimes they cannot be combined with.

## Taxes
- [Tax Residency in Georgia: The 183-Day Rule and the HNWI Route (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/tax-residency-georgia/): How Georgia decides individual tax residency under Article 34 of the Tax Code — the rolling 183-day count, how days are counted, why citizenship is not the test, and the High Net Worth Individual route (3M GEL property or 200,000 GEL income plus a Georgian nexus) with annual renewal; plus how to get a residency certificate.
- [Personal Income Tax and Territorial Taxation in Georgia (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/personal-income-tax-georgia/): The flat 20% rate and the territorial system — residents taxed only on Georgian-source income (Art 82), non-residents on Georgian-source income (Art 79), sourcing under Art 104, the trap that work performed in Georgia is Georgian-source even with foreign clients, and the 1% small-business alternative.
- [Crypto Tax for Individuals in Georgia (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/crypto-tax-georgia/): Public Ruling N201 of 28 June 2019 — individuals exempt from income tax on crypto gains, crypto-to-fiat VAT-exempt, hash-power rules, and the limits (crypto received as payment for work is still taxable; companies taxed differently); how it differs from the VASP licensing regime.
- [Double Tax Treaties (DTAA) in Georgia: The Full Country List and How They Work (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/double-tax-treaties-georgia/): All 58 in-force treaties, how they allocate taxing rights and cap withholding on dividends/interest/royalties, claiming relief under Decree N633 with a residency certificate, and the MLI anti-abuse rules covering 34 of the 58.

## Study in Georgia
- [Universities in Georgia: Higher Education for International Students](https://relocation.ge/en/universities-in-georgia/): The Bologna system, NCEQE authorisation and accreditation, English-taught degrees and diploma recognition.
- [Student Visa & Residence in Georgia (D3)](https://relocation.ge/en/student-visa-and-residence-georgia/): Entering on the D3 study visa and converting it into a study residence permit.
- [Studying Medicine in Georgia (MD/MBBS)](https://relocation.ge/en/studying-medicine-in-georgia/): Six-year English MD programmes, costs, WDOMS listing and licensing recognition abroad.
- [University Admissions & Enrolment](https://relocation.ge/en/admissions-and-enrolment-georgia/): Choosing an accredited programme, NCEQE recognition, apostille/legalisation, language and intakes.
- [Recognition of Foreign Diplomas (NCEQE)](https://relocation.ge/en/recognition-of-foreign-diplomas-georgia/): Recognising a foreign qualification in Georgia and legalising a Georgian diploma for use abroad.
- [Tuition Fees & Cost of Studying](https://relocation.ge/en/tuition-and-cost-of-studying-georgia/): Indicative tuition ranges, living costs and extra fees for international students.
- [Working While Studying](https://relocation.ge/en/working-while-studying-georgia/): Why a study permit alone does not allow work, and the 2026 work-permit requirement.
- [Scholarships for Studying in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/scholarships-in-georgia/): Erasmus+, government and bilateral schemes, university discounts and self-funding.

## Live in Georgia
- [Banking in Georgia: a guide for foreigners](https://relocation.ge/en/banking-in-georgia/): Opening bank accounts as a foreigner.
- [Health Insurance in Georgia for Foreigners (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/health-insurance-in-georgia-for-foreigners/): Mandatory entry insurance under Decree No 602 and healthcare options for residents.
- [Buying Property in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/buying-property-in-georgia-for-foreigners/): Real estate ownership for foreigners, the agricultural-land exception and Public Registry transfer.
- [Renting a Home in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/renting-a-home-in-georgia/): Tenant and landlord rules under the Civil Code — rent, deposits, term and termination.
- [Cost of Living in Georgia (2026)](https://relocation.ge/en/cost-of-living-in-georgia/): Indicative monthly budgets, rent, food, transport and utilities.
- [Driving in Georgia: Licences & Car Registration](https://relocation.ge/en/driving-in-georgia/): Using and exchanging a foreign licence, importing a car, and compulsory MTPL insurance.
- [Getting a Personal Number & Tax ID](https://relocation.ge/en/personal-number-and-tax-id-georgia/): The 11-digit personal number (ID card) versus the 9-digit Revenue Service tax ID.
- [Healthcare in Georgia: Seeing a Doctor & Pharmacies](https://relocation.ge/en/healthcare-in-georgia/): Private clinics, pharmacies, emergency 112, and paying via insurance.
- [Mobile & Internet in Georgia](https://relocation.ge/en/mobile-and-internet-in-georgia/): SIM cards, operators, mobile data and home fibre broadband.

## About
- [Methodology](https://relocation.ge/en/methodology/): How content is sourced, reviewed and versioned.

## Notes
- Content is guidance based on published law, not legal advice.
- Languages: English at launch; more to follow.
